name: Zor Lonetree
summary: At Grommash Hold, Zor Lonetree weighs the Horde’s concerns beyond Durotar. His grasp of Alliance politics helps the court judge affairs across Kalimdor.

sections.title: Advisor in Grommash Hold
sections.body:
From Grommash Hold, Zor Lonetree watches beyond Durotar. He advises the Horde’s high leadership and understands human and Alliance politics with unusual care. When foreign curiosities reach Orgrimmar, he studies them. When trouble stirs among the land’s spirits, he directs travelers toward it.

His work keeps the warchief’s court informed on political and spiritual matters. Zor Lonetree has examined noble jewelry recovered from human settlements. He has also followed disturbances among the spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.answer: Zor Lonetree advises the Horde from Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. His keen grasp of Alliance politics and interest in Kalimdor’s spiritual matters make him a useful counselor.

faq.q: Where can I find Zor Lonetree?
faq.answer: You can find Zor Lonetree inside Grommash Hold, in the Valley of Wisdom at the heart of Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What tasks does Zor Lonetree give adventurers?
faq.answer: Zor Lonetree sends Horde champions to aid the spirits of Stonetalon Peak and soothe elemental unrest in the Stonetalon Mountains. He also studies strange human relics brought to the capital by scouts.

faq.q: Why is Zor Lonetree knowledgeable about the Alliance?
aliases: why does zor know alliance politics
faq.answer: Zor Lonetree studies foreign affairs and statecraft. He examines human aristocratic customs and Alliance movements, which helps him read noble signets, regalia, and tactical motives that other orcs might overlook.

angles.text: As a Horde scout near human enclaves or disputed borders, you can turn to Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar to interpret enemy intentions and relics.
As a shaman answering disturbed elemental forces, you share common cause with Zor Lonetree, who watches the suffering spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains.
